text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping at the 
shopping district with Tanino Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hm, that is...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The lottery...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Like an arrow, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That which determines destiny 
through coincidence and inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That's the arrow. Right now, here, you 
could say that small ball is playing that 
role."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Once that ball is dropped, our fates will 
be sealed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not entirely sure, but is she 
interested in the lottery... or something?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, when I acquired the offerings 
earlier, I obtained a 'bow'—which is to 
say, a voucher.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, let us loose the arrow. Whether 
what visits us be salvation, or ruin... 
Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet finished registering, and 
with bold flair, gave the lottery wheel a 
spin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We've been chosen for the Ark...!! We were 
chosen, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have earned the right to venture into a 
new horizon—the hot springs!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, hahaha—!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!! Aahahaha!! Aaaaaaaaahahaha!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, to the land of passion!! To the 
place where hot springs rage and gush 
forth!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: By the way—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Having read the overview, it appears the 
ark seats only two. What shall we do, 
Trainer?"
choice_data_list:
What do you mean by "what should we 
do"...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow passenger boarding the ark, I 
simply want to hear your opinion.
choice_data_list: Wait, does that mean you're coming too!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You bore witness to my destiny 
here. If so, it is only fitting that we 
walk this path together.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However... we are in the middle of battle. 
I believe now is not the time to stop 
running. What say you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, I didn't even need to ask.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall leave it to my future self. 
When the time comes, I will consider it 
anew.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Could this be—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What an intellectually inspired design!! 
Truly a cultural enlightenment! The dawn 
of a new era—!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Look upon this color scheme! A 
calming rust, paired with a vibrant, 
living orange!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From medieval to modern times, orange has 
been used to striking effect, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be the first time it's ever 
been used so boldly...?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this design couldn't 
possibly exist without intelligence!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!! Splendid, absolutely splendid!! 
I shall partake with all my heart and 
soul!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, on the way home, I was treated 
to a lengthy discourse on Tanino Gimlet's 
personal aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. It seems the Goddess of Harvest 
smiles upon us.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it is quite a massive quantity. 
What should I do—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Ha!! What in the world...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Look at the carrot in your right hand!! 
That perfectly rounded shape is 
unquestionably Doric!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And the carrot in her left hand! With its 
delicate leaves, that shape is undeniably 
a Corinthian column!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: In other words—heh, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Using these pillars as a foundation, build 
a temple... Is that what you ask, Goddess 
of Abundance?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!! Very well!! As the goddess 
wills, let us build a temple!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I walked along the path back 
to the academy while listening to Tanino 
Gimlet talk about the blueprints for a 
Carrot Temple.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"It's not what I'd call plentiful, but... 
it should be enough to make a drink for 
one person."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we have walked a long road today.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words... if I am not mistaken, 
your body right now is craving a drop to 
quench its thirst. ...Am I right?
choice_data_list: True, I guess my throat is a bit dry.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then let us head back. On the way, 
why don't you tell me all about your 
tastes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed home while discussing 
carrot-based drinks with Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...So this is the outcome, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it seems the arrow missed 
the mark.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, we are not William Tell. Our 
opportunities are boundless.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I shall accept this tissue 
for now... and prepare for next time."
